list.name: market
list.label: Market
list.query:
WITH price_report AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE h.tpmerc
      WHEN '010' THEN 'Spot'
      WHEN '012' THEN 'Call exercise'
      WHEN '013' THEN 'Put exercise'
      WHEN '017' THEN 'Auction'
      WHEN '020' THEN 'Odd lot'
      WHEN '030' THEN 'Forward'
      WHEN '050' THEN 'Future (gain retention)'
      WHEN '060' THEN 'Future (continuous)'
      WHEN '070' THEN 'Call option'
      WHEN '080' THEN 'Put option'
      ELSE coalesce('Code ' || h.tpmerc, 'Other')
    END AS market_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet') p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dtpreg, codneg, any_value(tpmerc) AS tpmerc
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE tipreg = '01'
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) h ON h.dtpreg = p.trad_dt AND h.codneg = p.ticker
)
SELECT DISTINCT market_type FROM price_report WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY 1

WITH price_report AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE h.tpmerc
      WHEN '010' THEN 'Spot'
      WHEN '012' THEN 'Call exercise'
      WHEN '013' THEN 'Put exercise'
      WHEN '017' THEN 'Auction'
      WHEN '020' THEN 'Odd lot'
      WHEN '030' THEN 'Forward'
      WHEN '050' THEN 'Future (gain retention)'
      WHEN '060' THEN 'Future (continuous)'
      WHEN '070' THEN 'Call option'
      WHEN '080' THEN 'Put option'
      ELSE coalesce('Code ' || h.tpmerc, 'Other')
    END AS market_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet') p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dtpreg, codneg, any_value(tpmerc) AS tpmerc
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE tipreg = '01'
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) h ON h.dtpreg = p.trad_dt AND h.codneg = p.ticker
),
d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, last_price, volume_brl
  FROM price_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND last_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market_type IN ($market))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
),
top AS (
  SELECT ticker FROM d GROUP BY ticker ORDER BY sum(volume_brl) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, arg_max(last_price, volume_brl)::DOUBLE AS last_price
FROM d
WHERE ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM top)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

      ELSE coalesce('Code ' || h.tpmerc, 'Other')
    END AS market_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet') p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dtpreg, codneg, any_value(tpmerc) AS tpmerc
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')

SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, market_type, sum(volume_brl)::DOUBLE AS volume_brl
FROM price_report
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market_type IN ($market))
  AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, market_type

    CASE h.tpmerc
      WHEN '010' THEN 'Spot'
      WHEN '012' THEN 'Call exercise'
      WHEN '013' THEN 'Put exercise'
      WHEN '017' THEN 'Auction'

      WHEN '050' THEN 'Future (gain retention)'
      WHEN '060' THEN 'Future (continuous)'

      WHEN '080' THEN 'Put option'
      ELSE coalesce('Code ' || h.tpmerc, 'Other')
    END AS market_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet') p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dtpreg, codneg, any_value(tpmerc) AS tpmerc
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE tipreg = '01'
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) h ON h.dtpreg = p.trad_dt AND h.codneg = p.ticker
),
d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM price_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market_type IN ($market))
    AND ('__all' IN ($ticker) OR ticker IN ($ticker))
)
SELECT trad_dt, ticker, market_type, trades,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS last_price,
  oscillation_pct::DOUBLE AS oscillation_pct,
  volume_brl::DOUBLE AS volume_brl
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY volume_brl DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15
